# THE LOOM

*What the successor instrument is for: the deck at home on its own torus,
with time threaded through it, a card kept beside the charts that derive
what it shows.*

---

## I. WHAT IT IS

The deck's true topology is the discrete three-torus: every trit wraps, and
the three circles are the three clocks, the orbit on time, the moon on
depth, the spin on state. No room of ordinary space can hold a three-torus,
but one can be lived in. The Loom is the body the study found, inhabited:
the twenty-seven at full scale in their round knots, the study's own ink
inherited whole, with all eighty-one moves drawn honestly at last,
fifty-four inside the room and the twenty-seven that no flat frame could
carry crossing the seams, every road one step long. The counts are measured
in the pins before the page draws them.

The neighbouring rooms are not furniture; they are weather. A wall stays
invisible until the thread actually crosses its seam, then the receiving
wall of the next room glimmers into being at the heat of the crossing that
summoned it, takes the thread, and cools away as the thread does. The torus
truth is performed at the moment the walk uses it, never asserted at the
cost of the body's presence.

A loom is the one instrument whose whole purpose is to hold circular
motions in tension and pass a thread through them. The shuttle is the
standing cell, the canon's own seating of the moment, derived from the
clock and never drawn; the thread is its walk, cooling toward the past and
grown only forward, for the loom does not unweave. An hour's step walks one
road; a step of flow against turn leaves the room and returns from the
other side; and when a count completes, the carry passes home through the
null, drawn as the thread's one lawful visit to the Seed, which is the law
the calendar has always kept. The sky's periods never divide evenly, so the
weave revisits everything and never once repeats: that refusal to close is
what a calendar is, and what weaving is.

The crank pours one flow through every wheel at its true ratio, slowed to
watch the shuttle walk road by road, quickened to watch the walk's weather.
Arriving, the loom is already weaving: the last hours of the real clock are
seeded so the first look shows the walk, never an empty frame. Beneath the
living thread lies the cloth: roads the walk has repeated this sitting grow
worn and bright on a gentle logarithm, recurrence shown as geometry, and a
fresh NOW is a fresh bolt, nothing kept and nothing sent. The rosette is
the loom's default face, the study's finest dress with time moving in it:
the octahedron of faces, the cuboctahedron of edges, the cube of corners on
their three spheres, the thread weaving straight through the shells because
the dress never moved a seat, and the shell the shuttle stands on breathing
with the hour, the restlessness as a tide, the still centre exempt because
the null is never lit. The instrument shows where the moment stands and
never what to do with it: there is no auspicious hour and no forbidden
one.

The live surface: [the loom](/app/luminara-loom.html).

## II. WHAT IT IS NOT

Not a second derivation: the torus, the seating and the walk belong to the
charts and the canon, and every count here is theirs. Not a rite and not a
reading: the Loom casts nothing, sounds nothing, keeps nothing, and a touch
only names, the Guide holding the meanings. Not the study either: the Cube
in the Hand found the body and is archived whole on the workshop's shelf;
the Loom is the body inhabited, with time moving in. Not yet in the main
navigation: a workshop surface until the architect graduates it.

---

## PROVENANCE

*Named at the architect's word, 11 August 2026 ("Lets build The Loom"),
the same day the study that found the body was archived. The name was
proposed for the instrument's own law: three circular motions held in
tension and a thread passed through them forever without closing. Rebuilt
the same day at the architect's word again, when the first weave read as a
diagram and not a body: the study's renderer inherited whole, the ghost
rooms demoted from furniture to weather, the arrival seeded, and the
rosette carried over and worn with time in it, at his word that the dress
deserved more. The torus's counts, the seam roads, the forward-only
thread, the carry's passage through the null, the weather of the walls and
the inherited ink are pinned in core/tests/loom.test.ts, and so are the
cloth, the tide and the default dress, which followed the same day at the
architect's word to take the rosette further. The card's only job is to
point.*

---

*The home is derived once. This is where it is lived in.*
